items.description: TripAdvisor has mashed up millions of hotel reviews with Google maps for a hotel search that sorts by user-generated popularity index and allows filtering by price and availability.
Find attractions on a map of Belize and other Central American cities. Click the tabs at the top to watch YouTube videos related to the city.
Twitter realtime feed. iGoogle style drag and drop with Twitter power search. Search current daily and weekly trends. Search TwitPics and audio.
Generative fiction with Google Maps and Flickr.
Enthusem is a service that allows users to send physical greeting cards online. Through its integration with Box.net, users can send cards containing content from their Box.net files.

Sush.io is a web application that allows businesses to connect all of their applications together. Sush.io focuses on automation, from automatically adding new contacts to invoicing clients. Sush.io saves businesses time by eliminating repetitive tasks.
Molamp is a really cool way of discovering and playing music. Search for an artist and Molamp returns not only videos from that artist but also recommendations of others to listen to.
This creation tool targets those who want to create their Google maps mashups and host the HTML pages on their web servers. You own the files you have created.
View travel videos from around the world using Google Maps and YouTube.
On-demand service offering management infrastructure and community building tools for API providers. Uses the Amazon S3 and EC2 APIs as part of their infrastructure.
This mashup allows users to enter a US address and returns a map of the address point within the ZIP Code polygon.

The UserTest.io site allows you to discover critical usability problems and improve your UX by user testing with UserTest.io. With UserTest.io you can Test your website or prototype to make better designs and validate solutions. You can also view test recordings to discover bugs, usability issues, and problems to improve your UX.
Lord of the Rings Online game map using Google Maps technology.
Online aromatherapy shop created using Shopping API. Price comparison with direct product links to stores. Aromtherapy.eu has subdomains for US, DE, FR, and AU. Main domain used for UK Shopping API.

Maps restaurants in Toronto. Use check boxes below the map to select from Indian, Chinese, Sushi, and so on, and then click the Show Selection button to map the restaurants of those types. Click a location to view a short description.
Facebook application for searching, rating, reviewing, and sharing summer camps. Put your favorite camps on the map and meet other friends who share the same experiences.
Find and locate Foursquare check-in deals anywhere.

eSignature Gateway leverages Amazon S3, Clockwork SMS, DocuSign, Google Storage and Twillio APIs to give users document sign functionality regardless of the email client used. In addition, eSignature implements electronic storage, data analytics and workflow capabilities.
Allows IT professionals to compare information about salary, job skills, and roles based on location. It also gives you an idea of demand based on the number of IT jobs advertised.
Tyke SMS is a software product that provides an SMS content delivery solution. Helps people send and receive SMS messages via web and email, even if your provider does not offer email to SMS gateway.

Browsing photos on Facebook can be painfully hard. In Sharendipity, access your entire social graph in Facebook. This mashup gives you a way to view all photos, whether they are yours or your friends.
Slideshow of most interesting and recent photos from flickr using the Lightbox Ajax tools.

Uses the SharedBook Reverse Publishing Platform, multiple streams of data containing the obituary, guest book entries and family photos automatically flow from Legacy.com to SharedBook where the content is mapped into a structured book product.
Demo of an atlas system for all-in-one-page access to large geographic data sets. Application plots various types of mines throughout the US, as well as agriculture and industrial areas.

These pages get links from RSS and Atom feeds and put the items on a map. Standard geographic encoding types are supported, but when your feed does not contain geographic information the scripts can attempt to determine the location of an item for you.
A map of nuclear-weapons-related sites in the United States. Features photos from Flickr.

MisoTrendy helps you find the most popular places around any location. MisoTrendy uses trending data from foursquare and shows currently checked-in users, tips and mayorships from the most popular venues in real-time.
Displays the Twitter public timeline in real-time with Google Maps integration.
Maps and descriptions of skateparks for skateboarding and biking in europe. User contributed content.

Care2 is an online community that aims to make a positive social and earth-friendly impact on the world. Care2 helps by connecting individuals with nonprofits and businesses that are making the world a better place. With Care2, individuals and businesses will be able to participate in, and support causes that matter most to them.
Ibiza and Google Maps designed for the iPhone.

The visual trace route tool displays the path Internet packets traverse to reach a specified destination on a Google Map. The estimated geophysical location of each hop is identified using the MaxMind GeoIP database.

Audience Partners is an enterprise advertising management company that focuses on on healthcare, politics and public affairs. With the Audience Partners platform, customers will be able to micro-target different messages to different audience segments in order to increase engagement and return on their advertisement.
Area based plots of US Census Bureau data.
The original 330+ identities, displayed in your sidebar. Uses DandyID - a free service that enables you to connect, manage, and share all of your online identities from a single location.
